retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century album layout featuring a single subject repeated in a sequential scale progression against a solid mustard yellow background with bold, stacked sans-serif titles.
triggerTerms: mustard yellow background with black and white figures

recipe.visualDefinition: A flat mustard-yellow field serves as the stage for a series of five black-and-white photographic cutouts of the same man in a tuxedo, increasing in size from left to right. Above them, two lines of large, clean sans-serif text dominate the upper third of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Sequential scaling of the subject creates a sense of growth and movement.
High-contrast black and white figures pop against the saturated yellow field.
Stacked typography creates a heavy header that balances the bottom-weighted figures.
Horizontal alignment of the figures' feet creates a grounded baseline.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic black and white subject cutouts
Linear scale progression from small to large

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures arranged horizontally across the bottom half, scaling from approximately 15% to 60% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest figure on the far right acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the large text at the top, down to the smallest figure on the left, and follows the growth curve to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the center-left area between the text and the smaller figures.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Forest green and sky blue typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast in the subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight in the primary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold Grotesque paired with a lighter Geometric Sans for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Solid color blocks for secondary logos

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and grotesque feel of the primary title.
Matches the geometric monolinear style of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid mustard yellow background. Place five black-and-white photographic cutouts of a man in a tuxedo along the bottom edge, scaling them up in size from left to right in a linear progression.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of left-aligned uppercase text in the top third. The top line should be bold forest green sans-serif; the second line should be medium-weight sky blue sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Are the figures strictly black and white?
Is the background a consistent mustard yellow?
Is the text left-aligned and stacked?
Does the scale of the figures increase from left to right?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the smallest figure is on the far left.
Ensure the green and blue text colors do not vibrate against the yellow.
Verify the tuxedo details are visible in the B&W cutouts.
Confirm the text is perfectly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid background + Sequential B&W cutouts + Stacked bold sans-serif header.
